answer.why: Both Virtus Investment Partners and Diamond Hill Investment Group are active asset managers that (1) offer investment management products including mutual funds and separate accounts, (2) serve overlapping customer segments—individual investors reached via financial advisors/intermediaries and institutional clients—and (3) earn AUM-based management fees regulated by the SEC. The core offering (managing client money across equity, fixed income and alternative strategies in fund and account wrappers) and the core buyer (retail investors via advisors and institutions) are the same. Virtus uses a multi-boutique structure while Diamond Hill operates as a single investment manager, but that is an operational difference, not a product or customer difference. Both compete for the same mandates.

T:P1.3.text: Virtus Investment Partners is a distinctive partnership of boutique investment managers, singularly committed to the long-term success of individual and institutional investors.

T:P1.5.text: Individual Investor Financial Professional Institutional Investor or Consultant International Investor Non-U.S. Investor (UCITS & QIAIFs)

T:P2.2.text: A distinctive company with a multi-manager, multi-strategy model

T:P2.3.text: A Message from George R. Aylward President and Chief Executive Officer

T:P2.4.text: Welcome to Virtus Investment Partners, a company dedicated to being a distinctive and trusted provider of asset management solutions for individual and institutional investors.

T:P2.5.text: Our goal is to offer clients high-quality investment strategies that have generated compelling performance and meet multiple financial needs. To accomplish this, we employ a multi-manager, multi-strategy approach that delivers a broad array of solutions.

T:P2.6.text: Each of our investment partners has a distinct investment philosophy and style, with talent and discipline that have been tested through market cycles and validated by performance over time. Importantly, they all share an unwavering commitment to investor success.

T:P2.7.text: We hope you will consider joining us as a client.

T:P2.8.text: Our multi-manager, multi-strategy approach gives clients access to distinctive investment strategies from independent managers.

T:P2.9.text: We have the flexibility, agility, and responsiveness of a boutique asset management firm with the product breadth, distribution reach, and resources of larger firms.

T:P2.10.text: Our multi-boutique model is based on the fundamental belief that investment professionals who operate in an environment that allows for the appropriate focus and culture can generate sustainable, superior returns for our clients.

T:P3.1.text: AlphaSimplex Group, LLC | Virtus Investment Partners

T:P3.2.text: AlphaSimplex is a systematic alternatives manager focused on delivering quantitative investment strategies that are attuned to changing market dynamics.

T:P3.4.text: AlphaSimplex strives to help investors meet their long-term goals in ever-evolving markets by analyzing market behavior and risk. Our investment philosophy is based on the Adaptive Markets Hypothesis, an innovative theory of market behavior.

T:P3.6.text: Virtus AlphaSimplex Managed Futures Strategy Fund

T:P3.7.text: Virtus GF AlphaSimplex Managed Futures Fund

T:P3.10.text: Chief Investment Officer, Portfolio Manager Industry Start Date: 2007

T:P3.11.text: Alexander Healy is the chief investment officer and a portfolio manager at AlphaSimplex, an affiliated manager of Virtus Investment Partners. Dr. Healy is responsible for the day-to-day supervision of the research team and the implementation of the firm’s investment strategies. He is the chair of the firm’s investment committee and a member of the operating and risk committees. Additionally, he serves as a co-portfolio manager of certain funds.

T:P3.12.text: Dr. Healy joined AlphaSimplex and held the roles of senior research scientist, director of strategic research, and deputy chief investment officer. He has developed various key elements of AlphaSimplex’s investment platform, including non-parametric investment models, volatility management overlays, and dynamic approaches to portfolio construction.

C:P1.2.text: At Diamond Hill, a First Eagle Investments company, we are fiercely committed to generating excellent, long-term investment outcomes and building enduring client partnerships

C:P1.3.text: We have been made aware that individuals are impersonating Diamond Hill employees on WhatsApp. These impersonators may attempt to gather your personal information or engage in fraudulent activities.

C:P1.4.text: Examples include a WhatsApp group promoting a free trial membership for investment courses offered by a member of our investment team.

C:P1.5.text: Please note, Diamond Hill does not provide subscription-based investment courses or investment advice. Diamond Hill does not contact clients or potential clients over WhatsApp, text messages, or from free email addresses such as Yahoo or Gmail. Diamond Hill will not ask for sensitive passwords, financial details or personal identification through WhatsApp.

C:P1.6.text: Diamond Hill is not responsible for any services or information offered by or provided to unauthorized parties. If you think you or someone you know has been a victim of fraud, please report the matter to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) at https://www.ic3.gov/, police or other relevant authorities.

C:P1.7.text: To block a scammer or suspected scammer on WhatsApp:

C:P1.8.text: Open the chat with the scammer

C:P1.10.text: If you want to report a suspected scammer:

C:P1.11.text: Select the three dots in the bottom right corner

C:P1.12.text: Check the Block and Delete box

C:P2.2.text: We are fiercely committed to generating excellent, long-term investment outcomes and building enduring partnerships. We accomplish this through our shared investment principles and client alignment philosophy.

C:P2.4.text: At Diamond Hill, a First Eagle Investments company, we are fiercely committed to generating excellent, long-term investment outcomes and building enduring partnerships. We accomplish this through our shared investment principles and client alignment philosophy.

C:P2.5.text: Our shared investment principles align our investment professionals across multiple capabilities, are foundational to how we invest and support our aim of generating excellent long-term investment results.

C:P2.6.text: An active, research-driven approach that capitalizes on our intellectual curiosity and unique insights is essential to deliver better returns than benchmarks or peers.

C:P2.7.text: Investing with an ownership mentality requires deep due diligence to build the conviction needed to invest over the long term.
